scope: Bound IMAGEDEF plan cardinality and dictionary-entry staging before DXF OBJECTS output.

behavior: Both image-definition plan setters reject more than DRW_Dictionary::kMaxEntries (100,000) before copying or moving records into the internal plan.
Plan materialization checks the same count before creating per-definition state.
writeImageRecord refuses to create a new definition when the existing definition vector already reaches the dictionary entry limit.
writeObjects rejects oversized IMAGEDEF inventories before opening OBJECTS output staging and reserves the image dictionary key and projected-entry vectors through DRW::reserve.

focused.coverage: ASCII/Binary inventories containing 100,001 IMAGEDEF slots refuse with no published bytes.

limitations: The 100,000 value reuses the existing DRW_Dictionary::kMaxEntries resource ceiling; it is not an Autodesk format maximum or a support claim.
The oversized plan-setter branch is not separately exercised with a 100,001-entry DRW_ImageDef plan; the output inventory guard is exercised without allocating image records.
Other writeObjects maps/vectors and unrelated copy/work bounds remain to audit.
next: Continue the P6 safety audit on the next bounded output assembly path. Keep allocation-failure injection and the separate rooted IMAGEDEF TABLES/FIELDLIST failure visible as open work.
